Round of 16: 20–28 October. Quarterfinals: 30 October – 7 November. Semifinals: 9–17 November. Final: 18–25 November (Pacific).
Forum body points at that schedule thread.
Places 3–16 stay blank. The wrap names [[Patrick Johnson]] winner and [[Greg Shaw]] runner-up.
